note: Standard Chartered Taiwan's card fees and interest (edition of August 2026): its classic (普卡) card costs NT$1,200 a year, waived for the next year by NT$12,000 spent on it in a year, or by 12 transactions, which the game doesn't count; revolving interest runs in four tiers from 7.9% to 14.98% a year (under a 15% ceiling), written at its top. The first-year waiver isn't written.
